## Problem and result

Describe the problem and what this PR changes. Distinguish implemented behavior
from a proposed design.

## Related work

Link the issue or roadmap task. Explain any change to the agreed scope.

## Validation

List the checks actually executed and their results. For documentation, preview
the Markdown and check local links and `git diff --check`. Do not claim product
tests passed if no product tests exist or none ran.

## Documentation and compatibility

Describe updates to documentation/changelog and any effect on the YAML or CLI
contract. Note unresolved decisions that need maintainer review.
